message: The other night, we experienced a surprise blackout just as I was settling in for a movie. Instead of panic, we jumped into our family group chat, sharing what little we had: I sent a pic of my trusty flashlight, my sister replied with her favorite lantern, and my brother chimed in about keeping the phone charged with a power bank. We ended up making a game out of it, creating shadow puppets with the flashlight! It was a reminder that even in the dark, we can shine bright together. What’s your go-to tip for making the best of a power outage? 🌟
